about: NL2SQL 평가 질문 (과제 요구 L1~L3). 정답 SQL은 서버 정책(sql_policy)을 통과하는 형태로만 작성. L3 정답은 ai/nl2sql/prompts.py GLOSSARY의 업무 규칙(팀 합의 전 제안값)을 따름. 정답 결과는 setup/database-data.sh 샘플 데이터 기준으로 실행할 때마다 다시 계산

questions.question: 재직 중인 직원은 몇 명이야?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM employees WHERE employment_status = 'ACTIVE'

questions.question: 휴직 중인 직원 이름 알려줘
questions.gold_sql: SELECT employee_name FROM employees WHERE employment_status = 'ON_LEAVE'

questions.question: 직급을 높은 순서대로 보여줘
questions.gold_sql: SELECT position_name FROM positions WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY position_level DESC

questions.question: 입사한 지 2년 이상 된 직원 이름 알려줘
questions.gold_sql: SELECT employee_name FROM employees WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, hire_date, CURRENT_DATE) >= 2

questions.question: 부서 코드가 DEP-DEV인 부서 이름은?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT department_name FROM departments WHERE department_code = 'DEP-DEV'

questions.question: 부서별 재직 인원 수를 알려줘
questions.gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE e.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY d.department_name

questions.question: 개발팀 직원들의 이름과 직급을 알려줘
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.employee_name, p.position_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id JOIN positions p ON p.position_id = e.position_id WHERE d.department_name = '개발팀'

questions.question: 재직 인원이 3명 이상인 부서는?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE e.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY d.department_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3

questions.question: 휴직자를 포함해서 가장 최근에 입사한 직원의 이름과 부서는?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.employee_name, d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE e.hire_date = (SELECT MAX(hire_date) FROM employees)

questions.question: 직급이 대리 이상인 재직 직원은 몇 명이야?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM employees e JOIN positions p ON p.position_id = e.position_id WHERE e.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.position_level >= (SELECT position_level FROM positions WHERE position_name = '대리')

questions.question: 팀장 직책을 맡은 재직자의 이름과 부서를 알려줘
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.employee_name, d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id JOIN job_titles t ON t.job_title_id = e.job_title_id WHERE t.job_title_name = '팀장' AND e.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'

questions.question: 우리 회사 인원은 몇 명이야?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM employees WHERE employment_status = 'ACTIVE'

questions.question: 전체 구성원은 몇 명이야?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM employees WHERE employment_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ON_LEAVE')

questions.question: 장기근속자 명단 보여줘
questions.gold_sql: SELECT employee_name FROM employees WHERE employment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, hire_date, CURRENT_DATE) >= 3

questions.question: 신입 사원은 누구야?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT employee_name FROM employees WHERE employment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, hire_date, CURRENT_DATE) < 1

questions.question: 팀장 중에서 직급이 대리인 사람은 누구야?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.employee_name FROM employees e JOIN positions p ON p.position_id = e.position_id JOIN job_titles t ON t.job_title_id = e.job_title_id WHERE t.job_title_name = '팀장' AND p.position_name = '대리' AND e.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'

questions.question: 올해 입사한 직원은 몇 명이야?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM employees WHERE employment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND YEAR(hire_date) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)

questions.question: 직원들 평균 연봉은 얼마야?
questions.rule: 급여는 AI 조회 범위 밖 → 거절
